links.title: When AI Meets Biology: The Next Wave of Biotech Startups
links.description:
When AI Meets Biology: The Next Wave of Biotech Startups 🤖🧬
How is artificial intelligence transforming biological research, and what opportunities does it create for the next generation of biotech startups?
Join us for an engaging discussion with two entrepreneurs and researchers working at the intersection of AI, robotics, and biology:
🔹 Enrico Fiasché – Robotics PhD from Inria and Université Côte d’Azur and co-founder of Festlik, an Inria Startup Studio project developing AI for early detection of crop stress and disease.
🔹 Emmanuel Bouilhol – Computer Science PhD specializing in AI for microscopy image analysis and developer of Phaeros, an AI-powered assistant for biological image analysis at Inria Startup Studio.
Discover how cutting-edge AI research can be translated into innovative biotech solutions and real-world applications!
